prompt: Write the body (about 250 words) of a Texas personal injury petition by a car accident victim against an auto insurer, with the parts Parties, Facts, Negligence and Damages in plain text. Accident: low-speed head-on collision. Injury: whiplash. Use the exact placeholders [PLAINTIFF_NAME], [LOSS_DATE], [CITY] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1185; do not mention it.)
text:
PARTIES

Plaintiff [PLAINTIFF_NAME] is an individual residing in Texas who was the driver of a vehicle involved in the collision described below. Defendant is an automobile insurance company authorized to transact business in the State of Texas, which issued the policy of insurance under which Plaintiff seeks benefits and against which this claim is brought.

FACTS

On [LOSS_DATE], Plaintiff was lawfully operating his vehicle on a public roadway in [CITY], Texas, when a vehicle traveling in the opposite direction crossed into Plaintiff's lane and struck Plaintiff's vehicle head-on. The impact occurred at a low rate of speed, but it was sufficient to force Plaintiff's head and neck violently forward and then backward. Plaintiff reported the collision to the police and to Defendant promptly and cooperated with Defendant's investigation. Plaintiff sought medical care the same day for neck pain, stiffness, and headache, and was diagnosed with whiplash injury to the cervical spine. Plaintiff has followed the treatment plan prescribed by his physicians.

NEGLIGENCE

The at-fault driver breached the duty of ordinary care owed to others on the roadway by failing to keep a proper lookout, failing to control his vehicle, and crossing into oncoming traffic. Defendant, as the insurer providing coverage under the applicable policy, is obligated under the terms of that policy and Texas law to pay covered benefits and to evaluate and resolve the claim in good faith. Defendant has failed to pay the amounts owed in a timely and reasonable manner, and its conduct in handling this claim violates the Texas Insurance Code and the Texas Deceptive Trade Practices Act.

DAMAGES

As a direct result of the collision, Plaintiff has suffered physical pain, mental anguish, medical expenses, lost wages, and diminished capacity to perform daily activities. These injuries are expected to continue into the future. Plaintiff seeks actual damages, statutory damages, attorney's fees, and court costs. Plaintiff demands judgment against Defendant in the amount of [DEMAND_AMOUNT], together with pre-judgment and post-judgment interest as allowed by law.
